text:
Devon (Support): Heads up — AcmeCorp says invoice INV-4321 failed at checkout. Customer tried paying with corporate card; got back 'card_declined'. Agent says sometimes 3DS popup appeared and sometimes it didn't. Can payments team help triage?

Devon (Support): Pasted sanitized attempt from gateway:
```
payment_id: pay_3Jk9z...
gateway: stripe
status: declined
detail: issuer_declined
decline_code: insufficient_funds
response_code: 402
3ds: attempted
3ds_result: challenge_timeout
country: DE
currency: EUR
amount: 24500
```

Maria G: Thanks. Quick Qs — last4? card brand? billing country? Do they need to pay via PO instead?

Devon (Support): Last4: 4242, brand: Visa, billing country DE, they mentioned finance requires PO for >€10k but tried to bypass for urgent renewal.

Samir - Billing: Two likely buckets: (1) genuine insufficient funds from issuer, (2) SCA/3DS flow failing (challenge timeout) which appears in the log. Also sometimes fraud/velocity rules can auto-decline corporate BINs. We should check gateway events for the full decline payload.

Alex W: Can you share the internal payment_id (we have pay_3Jk9z...). I'll pull the raw provider webhook events. Running stripe events lookup now.

payments-bot: Retrieved events for pay_3Jk9z... (redacted). 3 events: charge.failed (insufficient_funds), setup_intent.succeeded (no), payment_intent.confirmation_required (3ds_challenge_required)

Alex W: From provider: first attempt -> authorization returned insufficient_funds. Second attempt -> PI moved to requires_action -> 3DS challenge issued but challenge timed out after 30s (challenge_timeout). Gateway did not retry. There's also a fraud_score: 82 on the BIN which may have flagged it for some merchants.

Maria G: Thanks. Customer on EU card so SCA applies. Two asks for support reply: 1) ask customer to try again and complete the 3DS pop-up (if they can) or use an alternate card; 2) if finance needs PO, offer manual invoice settlement via bank transfer and add steps. Also flag for our account exec so they can arrange card/PO.

Devon (Support): Replied to customer asking them to try an alternate card and shared manual wire instructions. Also asked them to try the original card in an incognito window to ensure nothing blocks the 3DS iframe.

Samir - Billing: For internal follow-up — suggest we add a small UX change to fallback to open hosted-invoice page that uses Stripe Elements for 3DS rather than iframe, since challenge iframes time out in some corporate browser setups. I'll open a ticket.

Alex W: For reproducibility notes: Steps we used to inspect:
```bash
# fetch internal event stream
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" https://payments.internal/api/v1/payments/pay_3Jk9z.../events
# stripe CLI (dev only)
stripe logs tail --forward-to localhost:3000/events --filter "payment_intent=pi_..."
```
Looked at event timestamps — challenge window closed before user completed.

Devon (Support): Customer tried alt card and payment succeeded. Marking resolved with notes to billing and product about fallback flow.

Maria G: Can we add a short KB: 'Why 3DS may time out and how to workaround (incognito, different browser, complete within 30s, use alt card or wire)' and link it to invoice emails. I'll draft it. :thumbsup:

Samir - Billing: Noted. Also recommend we whitelist AcmeCorp for velocity/fraud checks for now after verifying with AM. Opening internal ticket PAY-2187.

Alex W: Closing loop — no gateway bug, combination of issuer insufficient funds + one 3DS timeout. Customer resolved by alt card.

Devon (Support): Closing thread. Will attach case #CS-8829 and email summary.
